q: Is this a real side hustle?
a: It can produce side income, but the work is not “side hustle energy.” If you can’t qualify, collect docs, and follow up, you’ll churn. Treat it like a performance business.

q: Can I become a business loan broker with no license?
a: In many cases you can operate as a referral partner without a formal license, but you still need to follow program terms and avoid misleading claims. If you want broker-level commissions, expect broker-level responsibilities.

q: What’s the fastest way to get paid?
a: Submit clean, fundable files. The fastest path is not more leads—it’s better qualification and faster doc collection.
It means fewer submissions with better docs, better fit, and better expectations. That produces funded outcomes and repeat business.

q: Do you provide scripts and a plan?
a: Yes—use the Playbook page for a baseline weekly plan and qualification script. For a tailored plan, use the 1:1 Q&A + launch plan.

q: What should I ask a business owner on the first call?
a: Time in business, revenue range, use of funds + urgency, bank statement behavior (NSFs/negatives), and credit reality. Then ask for docs early.
